newsitem.title: USA: Sky Games to merge with joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Sky Games to merge with joint venture.

text.p: Sky Games International Inc on Tuesday said it would merge with Interactive Entertainment Ltd, its 80 percent-owned joint venture with Harrah's Entertainment Inc.
Gordon Stevenson, president of Interactive Entertainment, will become president and chief executive of the merged company when the deal closes April 15.
The company said it would also change its name to Interactive Entertainment Ltd and move its headquarters to Memphis, Tennessee.
Interactive Entertainment develops remote control gaming software for use on international airline flights.
Sky Games also said Harrah's planned to invest up to $1.65 million in Sky Games by July 15, becoming the company's largest stockholder with a 31 percent stake.
The company's shares closed up 1/4 at five.
